verdict.rationale: Angular ships a generic `ng deploy` builder that can invoke platform-specific deploy adapters, and Angular Universal is confirmed for server-side rendering, suggesting some path to hosted deployment. However there is no evidence of first-party or documented integrations for specific serverless/edge runtimes (e.g., Vercel Edge, Cloudflare Workers, AWS Lambda) or any confirmation that this works without extra infrastructure configuration. Missing for 10: explicit edge/serverless deploy adapters, documentation of zero-config deployment to a named serverless/edge platform, and independent confirmation of successful deployment.
